race.comment: REGOR (1) joins the Matthew Dale stable for his first NSW start. Has undergone the ultimate gear change (gelded) during the break and while he's yet to be seen at any public work, his market support back in Vic suggests there's ability in him. Heywood's booking is a big push and the inside pillar is another bonus. Bright return anticipated. BURN SUGAR BURN (7) also resumes and has been given two trials, the latest a third at Goulburn. She can improve on a debut run where a slow start left her with too much to do. MAGIC BUS (3) is the unknown quantity on debut but his late work in the recent trial suggests he can make an impact. JENNI MOO MOO (6) is race-fit but has had a few chances now. Keeping safe.
